name: ios-forensics
description: iOS forensics and mercenary-spyware triage via MVT (Mobile Verification Toolkit). Provides curated modules over iTunes/Finder backups and full-filesystem extractions for device posture, communications, location/activity, configuration profiles, and spyware detection (Pegasus, Predator, QuaDream, RCS) driven by STIX IoCs, plus an escape hatch for the full MVT module catalog and raw SQLite/plist/Manifest.db helpers. Includes playbooks for image triage, spyware hunts, communications analysis, activity reconstruction, and configuration/persistence review.
